offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance and reinsurance for businesses and some individuals. Sells mainly through independent agents and brokers, earning premiums while paying claims and investing reserves.

primary_products.value: commercial liability insurance; commercial auto insurance; property insurance; workers' compensation insurance; professional liability insurance; reinsurance

primary_services.value: claims handling for insured businesses; risk management for policyholders

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses across many industries buying liability, property and workers' compensation coverage; B2C: individuals buying personal auto and property coverage

end_markets.value: commercial construction; transportation; healthcare; manufacturing; professional services

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums paid for insurance policies, plus investment income on held funds

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums from businesses and individuals and bears the insured risk

geography_served.value: global: all US states, plus Europe, Asia, Latin America and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: commercial specialty, excess and surplus, professional liability, workers' compensation, reinsurance and international insurance units

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent agents and wholesale brokers placing business with the company; direct sales: in-house underwriters selling directly to some insureds; own locations: regional offices across the US and in international markets
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; direct sales; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensing and solvency rules enforced by state insurance regulators, the NAIC and foreign insurance regulators
